articles.summary: Ricardo Baptiste rejoins Ameriprise after spending six years at Raymond James Private wealth advisor Ricardo Baptiste, CFP® , has rejoined Ameriprise Financial, Inc. (NYSE: AMP) in Plantation, Fla., after six years with Raymond James. Baptiste, who spent 23 years at Ameriprise before moving to Raymond James in 2020, returns to Ameriprise’s independent channel with $193 million in client assets. His practice, Wealth Investment Group, includes Financial Planning Assistant Zachary Rosen and Client Service Specialist Josie Felix . “My experience away reinforced what I value about Ameriprise and what’s important to me in a long-term partner for my practice,” said Baptiste. “I knew I needed a firm that shared my commitment to comprehensive financial planning, independence, advisor success, and an elevated client experience. Ultimately, those priorities brought me back to Ameriprise, where I spent more than two decades building my practice and helping clients achieve their financial goals.”
articles.title: Experienced Advisor with Over $190 Million in Assets Returns to Ameriprise Citing Financial Planning Capabilities, Technology and a Vision for Advisor Growth

articles.summary: Partnership gives TFCU Wealth Management clients’ access to impressive suite of solutions and services offered by Ameriprise Financial Ameriprise Financial, Inc. (NYSE: AMP) today announced Tinker Federal Credit Union (TFCU), a member-owned financial cooperative headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, has transitioned its investment program to the Ameriprise Financial Institution Group (AFIG) from Raymond James Financial Services, Inc. TFCU has 30+ locations in Oklahoma and Texas and more than $6.1 billion in assets. The credit union’s investment program now operates under the name TFCU Wealth Management, a financial advisory practice of Ameriprise Financial Services, LLC.
